title: Smallest Structural Irrigation Seam: Fixed Events

selected_smallest_seam.legacy_scope: B1.10 irrigation(task=3) fixed irrigation event path plus task=9-equivalent event completion semantics
includes: fixed event cursor equivalent to nirri
application type 0/1 surface gross irrigation rate
irrigation concentration metadata for application types 0/1
excludes: meteo/interception conversion from gird to nird
selected_smallest_seam.reason: The fixed-event route is the smallest physical irrigation seam with real persistent event history and both surface and SSDI outputs, while avoiding premature migration of the larger hydraulic/crop trigger surface.

translation_contract.event_time: already translated to the runtime time coordinate used for t0/t1
translation_contract.surface_depth: legacy post-read internal irdepth in cm
translation_contract.surface_rate: legacy post-read internal irrate in cm/day
translation_contract.ssdi_depth: legacy post-read internal irdepth after division by the number of SSDI nodes; therefore this is per-active-node event depth
translation_contract.ssdi_rate: legacy post-read internal irrate in cm/day, applied to every node from ssdi_first_node through ssdi_last_node
translation_contract.ssdi_total_identity: number_of_ssdi_nodes * rate * (per_node_depth/rate) equals total original irrigation depth
translation_contract.concentration: legacy cirr is assigned from irconc only for application_type < 2; SSDI leaves cirr at the task-3 reset value zero

data_separation.immutable_parameters: translated fixed event table plus optional SSDI node range; legacy I/O remains outside the process
data_separation.persistent_state: next fixed-event index and only the active-event identity/timing needed for continuation
data_separation.physical_result: surface gross irrigation rate or optional SSDI node source, application type, concentration and applied external inflow amount
data_separation.temporary_workspace: locals only; no persistent solver scratch

time_semantics.event_end: candidate state clears the active event when t1 reaches the event end, representing task=9 completion without global mutation

mass_contract.surface_process_rate_sign: positive gross irrigation amount; downstream top-boundary adapter owns solver sign conversion

hydraulic_view.reason: B1.10 fixed-event selection depends on date/cursor and event parameters, not h/theta; adding an unused hydraulic dependency would violate smallest-seam design.

qualification_requirements: state continuation across an event boundary split
scientific_admission: Independent F-VQ remains required after structural qualification.
